page: UpCloud GPU-12xCPU-128GB-1xL40S is a GPU-accelerated cloud server built on the KVM hypervisor. The instance integrates an AMD EPYC 9575F processor providing 12 vCPUs across 12 physical cores clocked at 2.0 GHz, configured with 1 thread per core under a shared CPU allocation model. The host architecture provides 64 KB L1d cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 16 MB L3 cache per core, alongside hardware support for vector and cryptographic instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX-VNNI, AES, and SHA-NI.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA L40S GPU featuring 48 GB of GDDR6 VRAM from the Ada Lovelace generation. The host system is provisioned with 128.0 GB of system RAM, yielding approximately 10.67 GB of memory per core. The server does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network-based block storage volumes for persistent data. One public IPv4 address is included by default.

Benchmark results reveal strong single-thread execution, with Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core figures placing in the top tier of evaluated hardware. Text processing and single-threaded bzip3 decompression also place in the top decile. In contrast, multi-core metric outputs from stress-ng and PassMark sit in the median range due to the 12-core ceiling. Memory subsystem benchmarks show high uncached read throughput of 288.12 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 154.63 GB/sec.

For machine learning operations, the L40S GPU achieves top-tier generation speed for small 135M language models at 368.94 tokens per second and strong performance on medium 7B models at 36.32 tokens per second. Performance moderates on larger 70B models due to GPU memory bandwidth and single-accelerator capacity constraints.

From an infrastructure perspective, this instance balances high-capacity GPU VRAM and dense host memory against a moderate compute core count. It is well suited for small-to-medium parameter model inference, image generation, video transcoding, and accelerated rendering workloads that do not demand extensive local IOPS.
description: UpCloud GPU-12xCPU-128GB-1xL40S is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for machine learning inference and graphic workloads. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor, it provides 12 vCPUs across 12 physical cores at 2.0 GHz, paired with 128 GB of system memory and an NVIDIA L40S GPU with 48 GB of VRAM. Benchmark testing demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU throughput, above-average large-block memory bandwidth, and strong generative throughput on small to mid-sized language models. The 12-core shared CPU topology delivers average multi-threaded synthetic benchmark scores. Local storage is not bundled, requiring persistent network volumes for data storage. With a generous memory-to-core allocation and 48 GB GPU frame buffer, the instance is positioned for AI inference serving, media processing, and accelerated compute tasks.
